content:
Jimmy Fallon on Monday sarcastically praised President Donald Trump for his soothing effect on the nation.

The “Tonight Show” host pointed to the president’s recent explanation for the Federal Aviation Administration’s grounding of flights across the country.

“The equipment is very old, in some cases more than 50 years old,” Trump said. “But essentially what you saw on Friday was very, very old equipment that had a heart attack.”

Color the comedian unimpressed.

“In times of crisis, he really knows how to keep us calm,” Fallon cracked. “Trump said the old equipment had a heart attack. And everyone watching while flying also had a heart attack.”

On Truth Social, another Trump excuse for the FAA fail was that “the Biden administration set it back years!”

“Morning Joe” host Joe Scarborough, who’s not a comedian, didn’t need a punch line to make his point.
